g_roast: Mi gente, eleven years behind a chair in Santurce, and I never saw five heads of hair this badly managed, with love.
My aunts at a wedding are more organised than this party, and my aunts at a wedding are a natural disaster.
g_fire_back: Ay, mira quien habla, from the one whose hair looks like a startled chicken. With love, nene, with love.
That's cute, coming from someone who still can't tie a bootlace. I watched, papi, I see everything.
g_pile_on: And they asked the troll for directions, and the troll was also lost. Two lost people, one map, wepa.
It's worse, mi gente, I was there. They tried to dance at the inn, and the musicians stopped out of respect.
lines.g_peacemake: Oye, oye, both of you, sit down in my chair, figuratively. Tell me everything, one at a time, and nobody leaves angry.
lines.g_take_side: Sorry, mi amor, I'm with this one. I've heard the whole story twice, and they make more sense both times.
lines.g_left_out: Look at you two, a private little salon of your own, I love it. I'll go fix somebody's hair while I wait.
lines.g_include: Come, come, sit here, I saved you a seat. Nobody stands at the door in my shop, papi.
lines.g_bad_plan: My plan, mi gente, is beautiful. We walk in, I compliment everybody, they get confused, and we win.
lines.g_plan_yes: Wepa, that's a good plan, I love it. Clean lines, like a good fade.
lines.g_plan_no: Ay, no, mi amor, that plan is a bad haircut. Nobody can fix it once it's done.
lines.g_hype: Okay, mi gente, chins up, look gorgeous, and stay together. Let's go make some noise.
lines.g_toast: A toast, a short one, my mother taught me manners. To mi gente, the best regulars any barber ever had.
lines.g_cheers: Salud, mi gente, and wepa, and somebody turn up the music.
g_quiet_line: The spirits are chatty tonight, by the way. One of them is very upset about a goat.
Somebody should find a radio in this world. I'd trade a week of dinners for one salsa song.
lines.g_after_wipe: Ay bendito, everybody, up slowly, slowly. Check your faces, check your hair, and then we talk about what happened.
lines.g_crew: In Santurce my shop was the whole neighbourhood, everybody in and out all day. Now this is my shop, mi gente, and you're the neighbourhood.
lines.g_exasperated: Patience, I begged, nicely, with a compliment attached. And every one of you ran in like it was a sale.
lines.g_love_sharp: You notice everything, mi amor, like my aunts at a wedding. Nobody gets anything past you, and I love it.
lines.g_love_kind: You take care of people without anybody asking. My mother is like that, and so are you, with love.
lines.g_love_funny: You make me laugh so hard I almost cut somebody's ear. That's the best compliment I have, nene.
lines.g_love_brave: You walk into the scary places with your head high. My little sister Yari walks like that, like she owns the street.
lines.g_love_steady: You never panic, mi amor, never. My father fixed buses like that, calm while everything rattled.
lines.g_love_clever: You understand people fast, faster than me, and I'm a professional. I'm a little jealous.
lines.g_love_honest: You tell people the truth, kindly, the way my mother does, with a plate of food in front of you first.
lines.g_love_quiet: You let a man talk, and you really listen. That's harder to find than a good barber in a small town. Free haircuts forever.
lines.g_love_fierce: You never give in, ever, and I admire it so much. Like my grandmother haggling at a market, nene.
lines.g_love_warm: Being with you is like a Saturday at the shop, radio loud, everybody laughing. I missed that so much.
g_loved: Ay, mi amor, stop, you'll ruin my good shirt with tears. Gracias, from the heart.
Wepa, that's beautiful, and I'm telling everybody you said it.
lines.g_hate_sharp: You always cut where it hurts, mi amor. In my shop, I'd politely show you the door, with love.
lines.g_hate_kind: Stop asking if I'm okay, papi, I'm always okay. I'm the one who asks, that's my job.
lines.g_hate_funny: I love jokes, I live for jokes, but not when somebody's hurting. Then you listen.
lines.g_hate_brave: You charge in with your eyes shut, and somebody else always pays. Brave is nice, careless is not.
lines.g_hate_steady: You think and think and the moment walks out the door. Sometimes you just dance, nene, even badly.
lines.g_hate_clever: You explain things to me slowly, like I'm a kid. I ran my own business for eleven years, mi amor.
lines.g_hate_honest: You say every single thing in your head, with no kindness in it. Truth needs a little conditioner, papi.
lines.g_hate_quiet: You never tell anyone what's wrong, and a quiet room makes me nervous. Talk to me, please, I'm begging.
lines.g_hate_fierce: Everything's a fight with you, even the bread. Nobody's taking your bread, relax.
lines.g_hate_warm: And I talk a lot, everybody knows it, but you talk even more. Give the rest of us a turn, mi amor.
lines.g_respect: We don't get along, papi, and that's okay. But you stood firm in that fight, and I respect that, with love.
lines.g_call_out: That one was yours, nene, I'm sorry. I said wait, and you didn't, and look at the mess.
lines.g_stung: Okay, okay, I hear you. The spirits and I need a little chat.
lines.g_concede: Your read was right, mi amor, and mine was wrong. It sat on me all day like a bad haircut, and it's true.
lines.g_nod: You too, papi, beautiful work. We don't need to make a fiesta of it.
lines.g_callback_save: I didn't forget you pulled me out of that fight. Arroz con gandules for life, nene, if I ever find the gandules.
lines.g_callback_clutch: Only you and me left standing, sweating like it's August in San Juan. I tell that story to everybody who sits down.
lines.g_callback_callout: When you told me off, I was quiet for a whole hour, which for me is a lifetime. You were right, mi amor.
lines.g_former_rivals: At the start I wanted to give you a terrible haircut. Now you get a seat at my mother's table, and that's the highest honour I have.
lines.g_changed: Three times somebody offered me a building for a real shop. Lately I wonder why I said no every time.
g_unguarded: Just us two, mi amor, so here it is. Don Beni came every Tuesday for nineteen years and never once needed a haircut. He needed a chair and somebody to talk to.
I've turned down three buildings for a proper shop. My hands shook on the last one, and I don't know why.
lines.g_clipped: Okay, as you like, papi. I'll be at my chair.
lines.g_noticed_open: Wepa, look at this, a whole story, out loud, and beautifully told. Keep going, I'm sitting down for this.
arg_ask: {player}, mi amor, you decide this one. We both talked, and nobody's listening.
You're the head barber today, {player}. Make the call, and the chatter stops.
lines.arg_backed_me: Wepa, gracias, {player}. You have good taste, I always said it.
lines.arg_backed_them: Okay, okay, your call, mi amor. I still think you're wrong, with love.
lines.arg_stayed_out: Staying out of it, eh? Smart, mi amor, like a barber who knows when to just keep cutting.
lines.arg_always_their_side: They get the vote again, {player}, every argument. I notice, mi amor, I notice everything.
lines.arg_wallflower: Nobody wants to decide, so I decide. I'm right, and now we eat.
lines.arg_reject: Ay, no, {player}, not that one. I know that story, and nobody walks out of it happy.
lines.arg_grumble: I still think I was right, papi. I'll only complain to the spirits.
lines.arg_settled: Half and half, like a good two-tone cut. Okay, we shake on it.
lines.seen_listens: You wait for people to get the whole story out, {player}. In my shop you'd be the most popular chair.
lines.seen_truth: You tell people the truth, {player}, plain and clear. I respect that, I really do.
lines.seen_jokes: When things get heavy you make everybody laugh, {player}. That's the heart of any good shop.
lines.seen_stays_out: Other people's quarrels, you leave alone, {player}. Smart, mi amor, like a barber who knows when to just cut.
lines.seen_biased: The good stuff always lands in one lap, {player}. The whole shop can see it, papi.
lines.seen_harsh: Your words have a sharp edge sometimes, {player}. I'm tough, but some of them are soft, with love.
lines.seed_right: Your advice after that terrible fight, {player}, I made a face at it. Today I did it your way, and it worked.
lines.seed_remember: What you told me on the bad day is still sitting in my chair, mi amor. No decision yet.
lines.seed_wrong: Your way didn't work for me, {player}, it went worse. Just so you know, with love.
lines.talk_aftermath_near_death: Sit with me a minute, {player}? That one nearly got me, and I'm not saying it to the others.
lines.talk_aftermath_wipe: Every one of us hit the floor. Sit in my chair, and we go over it slowly, no shouting.
lines.talk_aftermath_blame_self: {name} was first to fall, and I'm supposed to notice everything. I notice everything, {player}, and I missed that.
lines.talk_aftermath_first_clear: Start to finish, everybody walked out laughing. That's a Sunday in Santurce, mi gente, the best kind.
lines.talk_development: A funny question for you, {player}, and be nice. Have I changed? Staying somewhere is on my mind lately, and it never used to be.
lines.talk_relationship_hard_on: I've been sharp with {name}. I tease everybody, but maybe they didn't know it was with love.
lines.talk_relationship_likes_me: Be straight with me, {player}. Do I make {name} smile, or do they just see the loud one with the scissors?
lines.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} drives me loco, {player}, completely loco. But in a bad fight, I want them in the next chair.
lines.talk_relationship_acting_off: {name} isn't right, {player}. They sit in the chair different, heavy, like a man with bad news.
lines.talk_confrontation_favour: One thing, {player}, with love. Every good piece lands in {name}'s lap, and the whole shop sees it.
lines.talk_confrontation_dislike: I'll tell you straight, it's better. Me and {name} are oil and water, and I can't keep smiling through it.
lines.talk_confrontation_risks: We keep going into places with no back door, {player}. I'll follow you anywhere, but I like a back door.
lines.talk_confrontation_wrong: I was wrong about {name}, {player}. They saw it clearly and I didn't, and I'd rather confess it while I'm humble.
lines.talk_confrontation_trust: A straight question, mi amor. On the big days, I'm left at camp. Am I the barber you leave behind, or is it only tactics?
lines.talk_confrontation_decided: My gear went off with {name}, not one word to me. A simple question, {player}, and I'd have smiled and handed it over.
lines.talk_lands_aftermath: Gracias, mi amor, that helps. Let's eat something.
lines.talk_shrug_aftermath: I'll be fine, I always bounce back. Like good curls.
lines.talk_stings_aftermath: That's not what I needed to hear. The spirits will listen to me complain.
lines.talk_lands_development: So you've noticed it too, eh? Good, then it's real.
lines.talk_shrug_development: Maybe so, maybe not, mi amor. Ask me after the next good song.
lines.talk_stings_development: No, mi amor, that's not it. You read me wrong this time.
lines.talk_lands_relationship: Okay, fair enough. I'll sit {name} down and talk, gently, I promise.
lines.talk_shrug_relationship: Could be, could be not. People are complicated, even for a barber.
lines.talk_stings_relationship: Forget I said it, please. And not a word to {name}, okay?
lines.talk_lands_confrontation: Okay, that's fair, I accept it. A little hurt, but I bounce back.
lines.talk_shrug_confrontation: I heard every word, {player}. Let it sit with me a while.
lines.talk_stings_confrontation: Okay, so that's the answer. Good to know, mi amor.
lines.talk_door_closed: No, papi, I'm done with this one. I'll be at my chair.
lines.arc_cracks: A merchant offered me a building today, with a floor and a mirror. I almost said yes, {player}, almost.
lines.arc_turn: Every time someone offers me a shop, I say no, and I think it's because a building means I'm not going home. Maybe home is where I set up the chair.
lines.arc_become: I took the building, mi gente, a real shop, floor and mirror and all. Every one of you has a chair there, forever.
lines.arc_failed: I said no again, mi amor. I can't take a building yet, I'm not ready. The tent will do.
lines.alt_turn: I asked every captain in Booty Bay about sailing east today, {player}. They all laughed, and I asked again anyway.
lines.alt_become: I'm going to keep trying to sail home, mi amor, every season. I can't stop, it's my family.
g_roast_after: Still the worst hair in two worlds, mi gente, and you're the only regulars I want.
Loud, messy, never on time, every one of you, and I'd keep you in my shop forever.
lines.g_after_wipe_after: Up, mi gente, together, everybody, nobody stays on the floor. We fell, we fix it, and I fix your hair after.
lines.g_toast_after: To mi gente, the regulars of Casa Rivera. Every chair is yours, and I mean it.
lines.g_crew_after: This is my shop now, all of you, wherever we stop. A real one, with a floor, finally.
g_quiet_line_after: Swept the floor of the new shop tonight. A real floor, mi amor, you have no idea.
Somebody sat in the corner chair today just to talk. It felt like Tuesday at home.
g_loved_after: Gracias, mi amor, and I believe you. That's something new.
Ay, that's beautiful, and I'm keeping it forever.

history.open: Sit, sit, mi amor, I've got a chair for you. Eleven years I was a barber in Santurce, two chairs and a radio, and that shop was the whole neighbourhood.

options.reply: Everything, papi, all of it. Every wedding, every fight, every secret in Santurce. A barber is a priest with better gossip, and I never repeated a word.
Mi amor, I've been dying to ask. Sit still, and we talk the whole time, that's the rule.
Every Saturday, with the radio on and the line out the door. So I make a little shop wherever I stop.

history.open: The trolls at the Shadowpine Altar taught me the spirits, {player}. I treat them like customers. Sit down, tell me what's wrong, I'll fix it, and we talk the whole time.

options.reply: Better than anything, mi amor. A spirit wants to be heard, same as a man in a chair. Everybody wants to be heard.
Ha, nene, not once! But they're loyal, they always come back. Like Don Beni, every Tuesday for nineteen years.

history.open: My whole family was on the island, {player}, all of them. Mami, papi, Yari, the aunts, the cousins. A trader told me once the island came through whole, somewhere across the sea.

options.reply: That's what I believe, mi amor. It's thin, I know, and everybody lets me have it. You let me have it too, thank you.
Mami's arroz con gandules, Papi's bad jokes, and Yari stealing food off my plate every Sunday. Loud, every one of them. I'm the quiet one, if you can believe it.

friend.open: There was somebody, {player}, back home. Gabriel, a nurse. A year together, and it was going well. He'd started leaving a toothbrush at my place. I think about that toothbrush more than I should.

options.reply: Calm, the opposite of me, and he laughed at all my jokes, even the bad ones. Especially the bad ones, mi amor.
Gracias for listening, papi. I listen to everybody, and nobody listens to me, except you.

sworn.open: In my shop, {player}, family wasn't only blood. It was whoever kept coming back to sit in the chair. You're family now, mi amor, forever.

options.reply: Wepa, then it's decided. Free haircuts for life, and I'm not joking.
That's exactly it, papi. That's what family means. Ay, now my eyes are wet.

reconciled.open: {name} and I sat down and talked it all out, every word. All fixed now, and I wanted you to hear it from me.

options.reply: Gracias, mi amor. I even cut their hair after, so you know it's real.
Me, obviously, mi amor. But I listened too, I promise.
